title: Schur positivity of the nabla operator on two-column modified Hall--Littlewood polynomials
summary: Bergeron, Garsia, Haiman, and Tesler (1999) introduced two Schur positivity conjectures concerning the action of the $\nabla$ operator on modified Hall--Littlewood polynomials. Although the proofs of the celebrated compositional shuffle conjecture and its rational generalization, along with various symmetric function identities, have largely resolved these conjectures in the affirmative, we provide an elegant alternative proof driven by $q$-series techniques.
